_description: 24 feasible (gate-length, wall-length) rectangle combinations exist, but only the two smallest (5x6 and 5x7) are small enough to fit in this tight 12x10 room -- every other combination has a side of 15+ units, too long to fit in a room with a ~15.6-unit diagonal. Player1 only tries its 10 biggest-area candidates before giving up, and the two that fit are ranked dead last (23rd/24th by area), so Player1 should return None. RandomPlayer samples length pairs and positions uniformly rather than ranking by area, so it has a real (and here, high) chance of stumbling onto one of the two small combinations and succeeding where Player1 doesn't.
